implementation: Active Flutter voice-room reconnect now stops before attempt seven, matching the web BoundedVoiceReconnectPolicy limit of six retries. The voice lease and room are released, and the selected voice channel returns to prejoin with an actionable reconnect error.

checks.name: Web retry budget boundary
checks.observation: Attempts 1–6 are allowed and attempts 7 and later are rejected, matching web retryCount values 0–5.

checks.name: Voice screen regression suite
checks.observation: Reconnect limit policy and all workspace voice, roster, and navigation widget tests passed.

checks.name: Native retry timing and real-peer recovery
checks.reason: Requires physical macOS, Windows or Android clients and a connected peer; the LiveKit Flutter SDK currently owns a different backoff schedule from the web client.

remaining: Match web reconnect delay/jitter timing if the native SDK permits it, then verify bounded recovery and lease cleanup against real peers on macOS, Windows and Android.
